title: MaceTechSMP
description: An open free-for-all Minecraft Server with lifesteal, farlands and Orbital Cannons.
body:
**Welcome to Macetech SMP!**

Macetech SMP is a survival multiplayer server focused on progression, a balanced economy, and unique gameplay. Earn money through shops, unlock new ranks, and build your legacy in a community-driven world.

The server features custom ranks, player shops, events, and carefully balanced mechanics to keep survival challenging and rewarding. Legendary items are rare, with special items like the Mace and Elytra limited in quantity to make obtaining them a true achievement.

Whether you're building massive bases, becoming one of the wealthiest players, or competing to own one of the rarest items on the server, there's always something to work toward.

**Join the adventure, climb the ranks, and become a legend on Macetech SMP!**
